_note: Synthetic. Mocks a read-only extract across Northgate's 3 SAP instances (per-company-code vendor data, per research/sap-domain.md). All supplier/entity names are fictional. The Vantpoint Fasteners case is the flagship duplicate-vendor scenario — one real-world supplier onboarded independently into all 3 instances with three different, conflicting tax classifications, exactly the EMEA manager's complaint ('the same supplier exists as three vendors with three different tax profiles').

vendor_master_records.onboarded_via: Acquisition A onboarding, tax classification set incorrectly at intake
vendor_master_records._flag: INCORRECT — this vendor is not VAT-exempt; standard_rate_21 is correct per V-EU1-4471 and V-EU3-2091's matching VAT ID. This is the error the prototype must catch.
VAT ID differs in the last two digits from the other two records (789 vs 780) — a second, independent duplicate-data symptom (stale/mistyped ID at intake), not just the tax-classification conflict.
Clean, single record — no duplication. Used for the happy-path demo case.
Clean, single record. Used for the Italy-jurisdiction urgency-queue demo case (a cross-border service this supplier bills to Northgate's Italian entity).

entity_resolution_map._note: What FR2a requires the system to compute: which vendor_record_ids resolve to the same real-world supplier. Precomputed here for the demo; in production this is the entity-resolution layer's own output, not an input.
